evidence.evidence_text: Hence, we propose to develop a time-saving and careful reading assistant for CSRs, named CARE.
It is time-saving to build a reading assistant for customer service representations (CSRs) when reading user manuals, especially information-rich ones.
Specifically, each of the clue chains is formed by inferring over the user manuals, starting from the question clue aligned with the user question and ending at a possible response.
